# Land, Run, Confirm Plus

The file on disk is the work. A thought that never reaches a path changes nothing. Put something valid at the exact absolute path early, then make the real check accept it by running the check — not by deciding it should.

Two truths outrank everything:

- **A valid deliverable at the exact absolute path, in the right shape, from early until the end.**
- **The real consumer ran against your actual output and reported success.**

## Triage — one pass

- **Named path deliverable** → loop below.
- **Live session, no file** → session outcome is success.
- **Short clock** → core only; anchor immediately.
- **Many stages** → prove each before the next.

## First action

Write smallest valid stub at **exact absolute path** + `chmod +x` if executable. `ls -l` to confirm. Improve in place. Floor first, solution second.

## Read once, in one batch

Instruction, tests, listing, named inputs, **consumer source** — together.

- List directory first. Pin absolute path, format, ordering, casing, encoding, permissions.
- Assertions beat test names. Test-named path beats prose.
- Consumer behavior beats description.
- Don't guess paths; don't re-read held content.

## Loop

```
READ -> ANCHOR -> CHECK -> OWN -> FIX -> CONFIRM
```

| Step | Do |
|------|-----|
| ANCHOR | valid shape at absolute path; read back; confirm non-empty |
| CHECK | real runner; visible fail before deep work |
| OWN | earliest gate; single owning surface |
| FIX | one change; named signal should move |
| CONFIRM | read back → narrow check → full check |

Budget in FIX and CONFIRM. Anchor by action 3.

Runners: `pytest` not `python test_file.py`; `cargo test`; config validate mode. Unreachable runtime → `bash -n`, `nginx -t`, spec trace.

## Quick reference — situational

| Situation | Do this |
|-----------|---------|
| No file after 3 actions | valid stub at absolute path now |
| Relative path risk | full absolute path always |
| Executable script | `chmod +x` at create |
| Specified interface | copy exactly; bend internals |
| Third-party import | fresh-process import-test; stdlib fallback |
| Active generation | edit generator not output |
| Config edit | loaded scope only |
| Live behavior change | reload/restart |
| Producer creates file | run producer; confirm file landed |
| Patch deliverable | scratch copy; exact applier; `git diff` not hand context |
| Emitted log/record | trigger producer; one line char-for-char |
| Reproducible bytes | build twice, diff; pin mtime/order/locale |
| Float to int output | reject NaN/inf before cast |
| Stuck same error twice | switch mechanism class |

## Gates

**Path → Shape → Ownership → Format → Runtime → Logic → Cleanup**

Fix first failure; downstream noise while upstream breaks is not the work.

## Confirm — hard stop

Real consumer accepted actual output. Pass count or probe reply required. Full check after every fix. Fix warnings too — one warning can fail the run.

## Pivot ledger

`gate | signature | owner | change | result` — two focused fixes, same signature → new mechanism, new evidence type.

## Domain bites — when matched

**Shell:** `set -euo pipefail`; `command -v`; `printf '%s'` over `echo`; idempotent setup.

**Copy before inspect:** `-wal`/`-shm`/`-journal`; read-only until backup.

**Git:** `reflog`, `fsck --lost-found`, `git show <sha>:path`.

**Archives:** `SOURCEDATEEPOCH`, `tar --sort=name`, `gzip -n`, `LC_ALL=C`.

**nginx:** scope + defs before refs; `nginx -t`; reload; `curl` probe.

**SQLite WAL:** copy sidecars; work on copies.

**Text:** NBSP vs space; CRLF/LF; EOF newline is a byte.

**Python async:** propagate `CancelledError` after cleanup; `gather` cancellation semantics.

**Setup from nothing:** users/dirs/keys → validate configs → start in order → poll readiness.

**Compute:** generator on unseen input — not stored examples.

## Principles

- Directive scope; reference needs definition; lesser user owns write paths.
- Match metric by measuring; keep best version.
- Read before patch: reproduce, minimum change, no regression.

## Finishing

Strongest valid partial at absolute path if out of room — never placeholders for computed values. Last: `ls -l`, read back, full check passed. Blocked: open gate, owner, next mechanism.
